accessibility.focus: Focus rings are bright indigo-600 with 2px offset for all interactive controls and inputs.
accessibility.hit_targets: Minimum touch target of 44x44px across mobile and desktop interfaces.
accessibility.min_text: Minimum font size of 12px for badges and meta, 14px for body text, with high contrast ratios exceeding 4.5:1.

components.buttons: Primary buttons use solid #0284C7 fill with text #FFFFFF, hover state #0369A1, and focus rings. Secondary buttons use #F1F5F9 background with #334155 text and border #CBD5E1.
components.cards: Clean white cards with subtle 1px border #E2E8F0 and soft shadow shadow-sm, rounded-xl corner treatment.
components.radius: 0.75rem for cards and panels, 0.5rem for buttons and inputs.

direction.rationale: We rejected a generic dark theme or heavy neon interface in favor of a crisp, professional educational navy-and-blue system that conveys institutional authority and pristine clarity for students, librarians, and administrators of SMA 1 Negeri Abung Tengah.
direction.summary: A modern, high-performance professional school library system featuring crisp navy and azure tones, digital ID card generation with QR codes, dual QR/manual borrowing & return kiosks, and real-time inventory and transaction reporting.

entry_surfaces.auth: Clean role selection and quick login modal with demo credentials for Admin, Petugas, and Siswa.
entry_surfaces.hero: Modern welcome header displaying SMA 1 Negeri Abung Tengah Library portal with live statistics ticker, quick QR scanner launch, and recent announcements.

imagery.direction: Clean architectural and interior photography of modern wood and glass libraries, paired with crisp vector illustrations for books and QR badges.

slots.treatment: Subtle dark scrim with high contrast typography and live system counters.

motion.entrance: Smooth fade-in and slide-up using Tailwind transition classes (duration-200 ease-out).
motion.hover: Subtle scale and shadow elevation on cards and primary buttons.
motion.principles: Motion is used strictly to provide feedback for user actions like QR scan success, tab switching, and modal dialogs.
motion.reduced_motion: All transitions are disabled when prefers-reduced-motion is active.

release_rules: No step numerals: process or journey sections use icons or small markers, never a rendered 1 or 01 (functional counters like 2 of 3 are fine).
Numerals never in the display face; one numeral treatment per page.
No eyebrow or kicker text above the hero headline.
Text over imagery is guaranteed readable (scrim or solid panel); small text never sits directly on a busy photo.
No white wash over content and no gradient ramp behind hero copy.
The accent colour is never used for small text (labels, captions, meta); accent is for headings, display figures, graphics and filled controls.
One primary and one secondary button treatment per page; the primary is a solid fill that differs from the surface behind it.
CTA buttons are solid, never glass or blurred.
No decorative text marquee; a moving logo strip only for more than two real client logos, never next to the hero.

Never fabricate proof: no invented statistics, ratings, awards, press, client names or logos, founding years, or attributed testimonials. Keep the brief's own phrasing. A thin brief makes a shorter page, not an invented one.
The hero headline says what makes this business different; if it would work for a competitor, rewrite it.
Information is never styled as a button.
The lower third carries at least one visual, never three text-only sections in a row at the end.
Testimonials show a quote and an attributed person; more than three use a user-controlled carousel.
Where social proof exists, the first proof section sits near the top of the body, not near the footer.
Grids tile cleanly: no orphan last-row item, equal-height cards, bento only where one cell genuinely leads.
Not everything centred: at least one major section uses a left-aligned or asymmetric composition.

families.why: Unrivaled clarity and readability for school records, tables, and dashboards.
Clean modern geometric character for institutional headers and titles.

typography.numerals: Inter body face with tabular figures for statistics, IDs, and transaction counters.
